The complete 1,293-pair discrete-Morse matching passes full Hasse-edge acyclicity on 11,430 covers and leaves one critical vertex and ten four-cells. The automorphism i→i+6 preserves all 27 edges. Signed chain traces for either nonidentity C3 element in dimensions 0..8 are (0,0,6,0,0,9,0,0,2), whose alternating sum is -1. Since ordinary H0 trace is 1 and only H4 remains, trace_H4=-2; identity trace 10. Rational C3 character equations a+2b=10 and a-b=-2 give a=2,b=4. This is a complete finite-object certificate rather than an extrapolation.
